name: Copianto
author: Copianto Ai

sections.description:
Build any AI chat with your data applications with ease.
*Documentation: AI-powered conversational search bar for documentation to help users find the information they need.
*Customer Support: Self-service customer support to resolve 80% of tickets and customer support related queries.
*Product Copilots: Intelligent assistants to help users get the most out of your products by providing guidance.
*Sales Copilots: Intelligent sales assistants that can help sales teams qualify leads and close deals faster

External services

This plugin connects to the Copianto Widget Service to load styles and scripts (‘https://unpkg.com/@copianto/chat-widget@latest’) needed for the widget display.
Data sent: None.
Service: Copianto (https://copianto.ai)
Terms: https://copianto.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://copianto.ai/privacy
